verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's own documentation provides an `extract_rules` parameter for 'Data extraction from CSS selectors'. The data-extraction guide confirms it covers 'CSS/XPath-based extraction', so the product directly delivers selector-based field extraction. The evidence is only one-line parameter descriptions, though. missing for 10: documented rule syntax and field/output-format examples (nested or list fields, attributes), and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract specific fields from a page using CSS or XPath selector rules
